Legal

Privacy policy

How we handle personal data when you use Webco Cloud.

Last updated 5 October 2026

Who we are

Webco Cloud is operated by Webco Services Ltd (company number 10607383), registered in England and Wales. Registered office: 2 Laurel House, 1 Station Road, Worle, Weston-Super-Mare, United Kingdom, BS22 6AR.

For privacy questions, email support@webcocloud.net.

What this policy covers

This policy explains how we process personal data when you visit webcocloud.net, buy a website package, use hosting, domains, email, Managed Care, the client area, or contact support.

Website design and build work is delivered by Webco Media. Where your project needs it, we share relevant order and brief details with Webco Media so the site can be designed and built.

Data we collect

  • Account and order details — name, business name, email, phone, address, company number if you provide it, package chosen, domain preferences, and billing information needed to take payment.
  • Project and support content — brief answers, content you send for the website, and messages you send when asking for help.
  • Service data — technical details needed to run hosting, domains, email and SSL (for example domain names, mailbox addresses we set up, and service logs).
  • Website use — standard server logs (IP address, browser type, pages requested, timestamps). We do not currently run third-party advertising or analytics cookies on this marketing site.

Why we use it

  • Contract — to take orders, deliver the website package, hosting, domains, email and Managed Care, and to manage your account.
  • Legitimate interests — to keep services secure, improve reliability, prevent abuse, and reply to enquiries that are not yet under a contract.
  • Legal obligation — where we must keep records for tax, accounting or other law.

Who we share it with

We only share personal data where it is needed to run the service, for example:

  • Webco Media, for design and build of the website you ordered
  • Hosting and infrastructure providers that power Webco Cloud, domains and email
  • Payment providers (such as Stripe) to process card payments
  • Professional advisers or authorities when the law requires it

We do not sell your personal data.

How long we keep it

We keep order, account and billing records for as long as you remain a customer and for a reasonable period afterwards for support, accounting and legal purposes. Support messages and project files are kept while useful for delivering and maintaining your service, then removed or archived when no longer needed.

Your rights

Under UK GDPR you can ask to access, correct, delete or restrict your personal data, object to certain processing, and ask for data portability where it applies. You can also complain to the Information Commissioner’s Office (ico.org.uk).

To exercise your rights, email support@webcocloud.net.

Cookies

See our cookie notice for how this site uses cookies and similar technology.

Changes

We may update this policy from time to time. The “Last updated” date at the top of this page will change when we do.

This page explains our practices in plain language. It is not legal advice for your own business.
